title: EntityManager doesn't work for quarkus scheduler
body:
```
@ApplicationScoped
public class Scheduler {

  @Inject
  EntityManager entityManager;

  @Scheduled(every = "10s")
  void run() {
    Company company = entityManager.find(Company.class, 1);
    System.out.println(company);
  }
}
```
